data.body: Claimed general-brinish-kookaburra (0933-ced1-b660-43d7) under already-in-progress parent ae4d-df34-480d-4c88. Its existing plan-review certificate remains current after refreshing to origin/main@bde9c4e66c7d501221ddc91e38507ed13a4879b2, so no review was rerun. The first MCP claim transport failed before execution; read-back proved status=open, then one retry succeeded with assignee joeoakhart@navapbc.com and push_status=ok. Dedicated branch comment-remediation-0933 now tracks that exact origin/main base. Scope: comment/docstring-only edits to 43 stable blocks across 18 tests/unit/workflow files.
